integrity: Analytic all-parameter derivation with a portable exact-rational finite generator checker; no independent scientific validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Two-site finite canonical symmetric inclusion chain with d>0 and stationary start; only first two asymptotic cumulants of the unsigned successful-jump count. Higher cumulants and full laws not derived. Poissonian Fano limit does not imply Poisson law; historical overlap may exist in generalized spectral/counting literature.
title: A sharp particle-number crossover for jump-activity noise in the two-site inclusion process
